Department of Transportation.title: FTA FY2024 full-year formula apportionments by state and territory
Department of Transportation.basis: FTA's state-total workbook reports full-year FY2024 apportionments and allocations through September 30 for 11 selected formula programs. The 56 geographic rows sum to $14.000572837B. This is an award-authority view, not an additive child of Treasury's $13.686B FY2024 Transit Formula Grants cash outlay.
